# A Reflective LLM-based Agent to Guide Zero-shot Cryptocurrency Trading

| **task** | Making daily zero-shot cryptocurrency trading decisions (buy/sell/hold proportions) for BTC, ETH and SOL using an LLM agent combining on-chain and off-chain data. | “This work aims to bridge the gap by developing an LLM-based trading agent, CryptoTrade, which uniquely combines the analysis of on-chain and off-chain data.” |
| **architecture** | Data collection and statistics/news summarization (GPT-3.5-turbo), then market analyst, news analyst, trading agent and a reflection agent that reviews the previous week's prompts, decisions and returns to give feedback. | “Finally, we enhance day-to-day decision-making with specialized analytical agents: market analyst agent evaluates market trends, news analyst agent interprets recent news impacts, and trading agent deliberates on investment actions.
